Round 36 passes. Typing a Clip Gain value without pressing Enter and then clicking any slider now keeps the value. I opened one Medium bug, C-R36-01, but it existed before this round, so it doesn't count against it.

**What I checked with real clicks**, at 1440├ù900 plus one check at 1280├ù720:
- **The main bug (C-R34-01):** I typed `3` into Clip Gain, didn't press Enter, then clicked music Volume, music Pan, Master Volume, video Volume and Zoom. In every case the SFX clip kept +3 dB and the "editing doesn't work during a drag" message no longer appeared. The undo history shows Clip Gain first, then the fader. A Pan click at the centre adds no Pan entry, as the ruling says. Two Ctrl+Z put back the Volume and then the gain. The 1280├ù720 Master check gives the same result.
- **Live audio while playing:** I ran 3 valid attempts in a loop and kept no instrumentation in the app afterwards. Each commit set the clip's gain on both SFX sources (the one playing and the next scheduled one), with no restart. Every SFX sound started afterwards had the new gain.
- **Other cases:** an unchanged value, invalid text (`-` and `1e`, compared against pressing Tab), detail start/end, search, a gesture already in progress, an already-focused slider, and clicking a library item all behave as specified. The round 33/34 regression checks all pass too.
